About the Team

McGovern Schwarz Group / Off The 56 is led by Bern McGovern and works across North County San Diego, helping buyers, sellers, and people relocating from out of the area find their footing before they ever step into an open house. The team builds neighborhood guides, market updates, and video tours covering communities like Oceanside, Escondido, and San Marcos, so someone new to the region can get a real feel for a place before deciding where to look.

Their focus stays practical: property search tools, home valuation, a perfect home finder, and a mortgage calculator sit alongside the educational content, all built to help you explore neighborhoods and understand which area actually fits your lifestyle before you start house hunting in earnest. For buyers coming from outside San Diego especially, that groundwork matters as much as the listings themselves.
